    def test_unknown_scalar_is_preserved(self):
        value = object()

    def test_hit_recursion_limit(self):
        data_list = []

        for i in range(10000):
            new_list = []
            inner_list.append(new_list)
            inner_list = new_list

        inner_list = result
        for i in range(10000):
            self.assertIsInstance(inner_list, list)
            self.assertEqual(len(inner_list), 1)
            inner_list = inner_list[0]
        self.assertEqual(inner_list, '********')
'''
